object_description: four differently proportioned building cubes around a central hall
design_condition: The cubes respond to adjoining urban structures through differentiated heights and setbacks, framing entrance squares while extending the park-like slope landscape toward the site.

positive.statement: The four differently proportioned cubes respond spatially in a differentiated manner to the adjacent urban structures.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views clearly show four distinct cubic masses with varied proportions.

positive.statement: The setbacks create generous entrance squares and a public boulevard-like atmosphere.

position.rationale: Setbacks visibly create open entrance areas along the front edge.

positive.statement: The building heights and placement establish an appropriate scale toward the villa-like neighbourhood and a transition to open development.

position.rationale: Differing heights and setbacks are visible toward the rear edge of the composition.

positive.statement: The clear basic structure allows a variety of organizational forms for teaching and research.

position.target: basic structure for teaching and research
position.rationale: Interior organization is unexposed; the marker uses the centralized building mass.

positive.statement: The height staggering creates high-quality open spaces directly assigned to teaching and work areas.

position.target: open spaces assigned to teaching and work areas
position.rationale: Open spaces visibly occupy gaps around the height-staggered cubes.

positive.statement: The compact building structure is expected to achieve construction costs in the lower range.

position.rationale: Cost assessment has no useful geometric location.

positive.statement: The project is convincing in terms of its assessed sustainability.

position.rationale: Sustainability assessment has no useful geometric location.

negative.statement: The proposed density does not yet convincingly reconcile the public character of the central hall with concentrated learning on the upper floors.

position.rationale: The centralized hall and upper levels are approximated within the visible stacked mass.

negative.statement: The central hall and upper-floor arrangements are not yet convincing in terms of spatial quality and lighting.

position.rationale: Lighting judgment is interior; placement follows the central upper building region.

negative.statement: Noise emissions along some streets can only be addressed through mechanical ventilation, which is inadequate for sound insulation.

position.rationale: Street-facing facade is approximated along the front lower edge.

negative.statement: The facade motif seems too direct and raises doubts about the desired expression of a university.

position.rationale: Repeated elevation pattern provides direct evidence for the envelope expression.
